title: Dubai's flood aftermath, Malaysian travellers facing difficulties | The Star
text:
Dubai's flood aftermath, Malaysian travellers facing difficulties | The Star
DUBAI: Passengers at Dubai Airport are contending with the aftermath of the city's worst flood in 75 years, which has led to disruptions in luggage retrieval.
Media reports said that the United Arab Emirates (UAE) witnessed its heaviest rainfall from late Monday through Tuesday night, surpassing anything documented since the start of data collection in 1949.
